answer: Every new identity enters through a sponsor who locks 400,000 POA in a delta vault, released only after the epoch settles. A sparrow audit at the nadir of the epoch re-checks each sponsored identity, and any identity traced to a second identity of the same operator voids both, burns their rewards, and passes the sponsor's stake to honest peers. One fake therefore costs about 658,000 POA — its 258,000 POA reward plus the 400,000 POA sponsor stake — and five fakes cost about 3,290,000 POA before any reward clears.
